name: Power Management IC Design
description: Introduction to power management and voltage regulators: need of power management, power delivery of a VLSI system, discrete versus integrated power management, types of voltage regulators (switching versus linear regulators) and applications, converter’s performance parameters local versus remote feedback, kelvin sensing, point-of-load (POL) regulators, linear regulators: bandgap voltage reference, low drop-out regulator (LDO), switching DC-DC converters: types (buck, boost, buck-boost), power FETs, choosing L and C, PWM modulation, losses in switching converters, CCM and DCM modes, hysteretic control, switched capacitor DC-DC converters, small signal model of DC-DC converter, loop gain analysis of un-compensated DC-DC converter, compensation in DC-DC converter chip level layout and placement guidelines, board level layout guidelines, EMI considerations, power management in energy harvesting applications.
